about: One colour per repo. Read it through lint/repo_colour.py (colour_for), never from a copy. A repo that has its own brand colour keeps it, read from that repo; each source names where. A repo with none gets a hue drawn from its name by the rule below, and the draw is stored here so a later repo never moves it. When a drawn repo gets its own colour, replace its entry and drop it from rule.drawn. The retired list maps a retired repo name to the repo that took it; no file may name the old one. Ruling: owner, 2026-10-26 20:37 CDT, roadmap step c105 (one colour wheel for every repo).
